chunks: They preferred to be with the women who stay at home, and a seal was placed on their hearts, so they do not understand.

key_terms.الْخَوَالِفِ: Women who stay at home (plural of khalfah)

ai.seo_question: Why did Allah seal the hearts of those who preferred staying behind during the expedition?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the 'Sahabat al-Sudur' (Companions of the Chest) who lagged behind during the Expedition of Tabuk, highlighting their spiritual stagnation due to a lack of active faith. The phrase 'khalifah' (plural of khalifa) refers to those left behind, and the sealing of their hearts signifies a divine consequence of their choice to prioritize comfort over duty, rendering them incapable of true understanding.
